title: Let a Space publish the Temple Theme Kit: TempleKit joins the live website themes, wired like Nocturne

verify.evidence: Fails on main (TempleKit is not in WEBSITE_THEMES_LIVE, so a Space that wears the kit publishes with the house look) and passes here.

detail: Space wiring of the Temple Theme Kit (code id temple-kit, shown as Temple). Everything else was already in place: the picker registration, the seed that maps temple-kit to the TempleKit editor theme, the kit home, the accent vars and the theme drafts. The one missing piece was the live set: a published website in a theme outside WEBSITE_THEMES_LIVE keeps the house look. TempleKit joins it. No live site wears temple-kit (old Temple, used by Royal Temple, is untouched and stays hidden from the pickers), so no live site moves.
